description:
Configure financial tracking for the organization by creating three new Cost Centers and associating them with their respective departments in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus.

1. Create the following Cost Centers under Admin > Purchase/Organization settings:
   - Name: 'Engineering CC', Code: 'CC-ENG-01'
   - Name: 'Sales CC', Code: 'CC-SAL-01'
   - Name: 'Marketing CC', Code: 'CC-MKT-01'

2. Associate these Cost Centers with the existing Departments (Admin > Organization Details > Departments):
   - Link 'Engineering' department to 'Engineering CC'
   - Link 'Sales' department to 'Sales CC'
   - Link 'Marketing' department to 'Marketing CC'

Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
